rating.comments: The student's own steps are mostly single answers with no justification, e.g. "2. like 2l i guess" and "640". They applied the earlier figures in "so if there are 320 students and we all drink 2l a day and we go 5 day a week calculate" and produced "3200 litres/week". The student asked no content question; "why me?" is procedural, and "no you do it" and "no." hand the work back or decline further engagement. Effort is rated 4 because the student made several task attempts and completed the calculation after prompting.
